capabilities: Import resources, tabs, notes and tasks from a Workona JSON file
Recreate the Workona workspace folder structure in the vault
Render each item as a Markdown file using Handlebars templates
Override existing files with the same name
Choose a root folder and supply the JSON via file picker or paste
extras: Hobby project maintained in the author's free time; donations accepted via ko-fi or PayPal. Users must first generate a JSON export from Workona themselves; the plugin does not connect to Workona directly.
motivation: The author built it for their own use, importing their Workona data in their free time.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring data exported from Workona workspaces into the vault as Markdown files.
summary: Workona import plugin that converts a Workona JSON export into notes, recreating workspace folder structure for resources, tabs, notes and tasks.
